units.rawText: My first encounter with the Professor... Umm... That's a little embarrassing. You see, I didn't exactly find my way to the Oasis—I got lost and just happened to stumble into it.

units.rawText: I thought I was on the path to the Neural Cloud Sector, only to find myself near the Oasis and face-to-face with the Sanctifiers. Then, Evelyn found me and brought me to the Oasis safely.

units.rawText: Hehe, that was a narrow escape. We were worried you might be scared at first, but you were in such high spirits when you saw the Oasis being built.

units.rawText: Ehe, it's fun to be around when everything's still being built! And after seeing everyone's clothes so battered from all the work and battles, I couldn't resist making new ones for them.

units.rawText: Clothing is an integral part of us. We choose different outfits for varying situations, allowing clothes to reflect our identity and express our emotions...

units.rawText: That's what my teacher told me when I was learning embroidery. So sewing is my thing, and I'm always happy to patch things up and design new outfits for everyone~

units.rawText: Oh, right! I've also made a new projection for you, Professor! Why don't you try it out~

units.rawText: Huh? You said it's new, but this looks pretty much the same as my old lab coat... Hm? What's this cloth made of...?
